hero.lede: Fullstack developer and co-founder, based in Dakar — I design and ship web products, from spec to server.
hero.desc: Three years writing Laravel, React/Next.js and Node.js for Senegalese and international startups. Currently backend lead at Société Africaine de Pétrole, co-founder at Teranga Dev and Nurapic.

teranga.name: Teranga
teranga.text: Senegalese product studio founded in 2023. We design and ship SaaS products and custom client sites — from the first mockup to the production server. Four in-house products shipped so far, including Creneau and Ticket-Events.

nurapic.name: Nurapic
nurapic.text: Event photography startup with a facial recognition engine. Co-founded with a business developer and a photographer. In production, built by Teranga Dev.

about.bio1: I've been a dev since ESTM. I started with networks and sysadmin, then switched to web and never really left.
about.bio2: These days I ship — Laravel APIs, React frontends, some Python FastAPI when needed, Docker and CI/CD to keep it all running. What I genuinely enjoy is designing a product with someone and getting it all the way to users.
about.bio3: Based in Dakar, open to jobs and gigs — locally, remotely, or internationally.

contact.text: Open to full-time roles (locally, remotely, or internationally), freelance work, and product collaborations. Email is the fastest way to reach me — I reply within 48 hours.
